baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired negations in لا ظليل ولا يغني من اللهب, anchored in ظليل, يغني, and اللهب.
baseline_models.mechanism: ظ ل ل supplies covering, غ ن ي supplies sufficing or standing in for something, and ل ه ب supplies active flame. The first negation removes the shade's expected covering quality, while the second independently removes efficacy, splitting nominal shade from actual refuge.

activation_trace.role: Shade as covering supplies the protective function that ظليل is expected, but denied, to perform.
Sufficing, benefiting, or standing in supplies the explicit test of whether the cover actually works.
Blazing visible flame supplies the hazard against which both cover and efficacy are measured.

changed_reading.before: A patch of shade gives poor relief from fire.
changed_reading.after: The ayah exposes an anti-shelter: something can bear the form or label of shade yet fail both as cover and as an effective barrier or substitute against flame.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ظليل and يغني permit a protection-and-resources mechanism within the focus wording.
baseline_models.mechanism: The protective-patronage branch of ظ ل ل and the independence and sufficiency branches of غ ن ي form two layers of security: external defense and one's own means. Their coordinated negation leaves neither sponsor nor reserve capable of answering the flame.

activation_trace.role: Protective shelter and patronage turn shade into external defense, which the adjective negates.
Self-sufficiency and wealth supply the internal means that also prove unavailable.
Availing and replacing make the failure functional rather than merely possessive.
The flame supplies the pressure under which both patronage and means collapse.

changed_reading.before: No physical shade can block the flame.
changed_reading.after: The wording can also stage total security failure: no protective patronage covers them and no independent resource or substitute avails them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The contrast between ظليل and اللهب can test darkness or visual screening against actual heat.
baseline_models.mechanism: ظ ل ل can image the darkness that covers at night, while ل ه ب can include rising glare, dust, or smoke. A dark or obscuring field may alter sight without reducing exposure; يغني then asks about causal thermal benefit and answers negatively.

activation_trace.role: Night darkness as shade supplies visual obscurity without guaranteeing cooling cover.
Rising glare, dust, or smoke supplies a visible or obscuring fire-field that can look shade-like while remaining hazardous.
Availing supplies the functional test that distinguishes optical screening from protection.

changed_reading.before: Shade is absent because the scene is bright with flame.
changed_reading.after: Darkness or smoke may be present, but visual occlusion is explicitly denied the status of thermal refuge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ظليل, يغني, and اللهب support a bodily relief mechanism without leaving the focus ayah.
baseline_models.mechanism: The shaded-water or grove branch of ظ ل ل joins the thirst-heat branch of ل ه ب: useful shade preserves cool water and relieves an inner blaze. The two negations remove both the habitat and its capacity to satisfy bodily need.

activation_trace.role: Shaded retained water or grove supplies a cool microhabitat expected to preserve relief.
Thirst-heat as an inner blaze supplies the embodied harm that nominal shade fails to relieve.
Sufficing and benefiting supply the denied transition from apparent cover to bodily relief.

changed_reading.before: The shade cannot stop external flame.
changed_reading.after: The failed shade also withholds the cool, water-bearing relief needed against heat experienced as an inner blaze.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding object is not formless darkness but a shade articulated into three branches. Canopy, three-part construction, and branching create an expectation that added structure should increase cover; the focus ayah reverses that expectation by denying both shade-quality and efficacy.

activation_trace.role: An overhead canopy supplies the ordinary roof-like expectation attached to the named shade.
A thing structured in three parts supplies explicit multiplicity rather than an undifferentiated shadow.
A branching extremity supplies the geometry whose apparent spread should have made a canopy.
Covering is the expected output that the focus adjective directly cancels.
Availing tests and rejects the tripartite structure's practical performance.

structural_cues: 77:30 immediately names a shade possessing three branches; 77:31 answers that noun phrase with two coordinated negations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies canopy, three-part structure, and branching; I infer that multiplied branches invite an expectation of increased cover that the negations reverse. Alternatively, the branches may simply enumerate plume divisions, but they still add structure without refuge.

changed_reading.before: The shade is weak or thin.
changed_reading.after: The shade is a deliberately articulated anti-canopy: its threefold branching multiplies form while producing no protective function.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated departure commands turn the failed shade into a destination, while the first destination is what had been denied as false. The focus ayah therefore describes not a bad shelter encountered accidentally but the endpoint of a compelled route where anticipated refuge cannot provide escape.

activation_trace.role: Unimpeded departure supplies motion toward the destination that will prove non-protective.
Contradiction of truth supplies the prior rejection that the destination now materially overturns.
Covering supplies the refuge expected at a destination named as shade.
Non-availing closes off the destination as an exit from the hazard.

structural_cues: The imperative انطلقوا and directional إلى recur in 77:29-30, first toward what was denied and then toward the three-branched shade.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated directed motion and a denied destination; I infer a route-to-trap relation in which expected shelter is the terminal exposure. Alternatively, the imperatives may only intensify taunt, but even then the focus converts destination into failed refuge.

changed_reading.before: A stationary shade happens not to protect.
changed_reading.after: The non-shade is a destination trap: movement that sounds like release terminates inside a refuge that cannot release anyone from flame.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following ayah makes the hazard projectile-producing: it throws sparks compared to an enclosed building. A form that suggested canopy or architecture is thus not merely porous; the apparent shelter-field emits the burning mass from which shelter was sought.

activation_trace.role: Sending or throwing supplies an outward causal arrow from the hazard to its projectiles.
Flying fire-sparks identify what the apparent cover actively emits.
The enclosed-building image lends shelter-scale architecture to the emitted sparks and reverses its protective association.
Overhead canopy supplies the architectural expectation that the next ayah inverts.
Blazing flame links the focus hazard to the following emitted fire-sparks.

structural_cues: The feminine pronoun in 77:32 resumes the surrounding hazard immediately after the focus denial and assigns it the verb ترمي.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a resumed subject, throwing, sparks, and a building comparison; I infer that the shade-field belongs to the emitting hazard rather than standing outside it as a barrier. The live alternative is that قصر marks size alone, though architecture still changes the shelter imagery.

changed_reading.before: The cover is present but fails to stop incoming flame.
changed_reading.after: The cover is continuous with the source of danger: shelter-like architecture has become an emitter, and even building-scale form arrives as burning ammunition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence separates two events often conflated as shade: stellar light is erased, while the overhead sky is split open. Against that pairing, the focus denial says that darkness produced by lost light is not a canopy, and a breached overhead cannot avail against rising glare or smoke.

activation_trace.role: The rising star supplies the light-source whose removal can darken without sheltering.
Loss of light or sight supplies visual darkening distinct from physical cover.
The sky as what rises overhead and shades supplies the large-scale canopy.
An opened split or gap supplies the breach that prevents the overhead from functioning as enclosure.
Night darkness as shade anchors the possibility of visual darkness inside the focus word.
Rising glare, dust, or smoke supplies the exposure that darkness cannot neutralize.

structural_cues: 77:8-9 coordinate light erasure and sky opening as adjacent but distinct cosmic changes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies extinguished light and a breached overhead; I infer an optical-versus-thermal distinction and map the breached sky onto failed canopy. Alternatively, the cosmic sequence may signal general collapse rather than describe the later shade's material physics.

changed_reading.before: Darkness itself counts as shade from the blaze.
changed_reading.after: The surah has already shown that light can disappear while overhead cover is breached; darkness therefore cannot be mistaken for cooling or protective shade.

context_deltas.mechanism: Stable resting, enclosing containment, watering, and sweet water form a compact life-support system earlier in the surah. Read against it, the focus shade is an anti-habitat: it neither creates a stable protective microenvironment nor delivers the cool sufficiency needed against thirst-heat.

activation_trace.role: Fixity and stable resting supply the first habitat function that the false shade lacks.
Gathering and enclosing in a container supply environmental holding and protection.
Giving drink supplies active relief rather than merely the appearance of a cool place.
Sweet fresh water supplies the quality of relief expected from a viable habitat.
Shaded water or grove anchors the cool microhabitat latent in the focus shade.
Thirst-heat as inner blaze makes absent water-relief part of the focus hazard.
Sufficing tests whether the apparent environment meets any embodied need and finds that it does not.

structural_cues: 77:20-27 progress through emplacement, terrestrial containment, and fresh-water provision before 77:29-31 command movement into failed shade.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stable resting, containment, watering, and sweet water; I group them as a life-support mechanism and read the later non-shade as its reversal. The alternative is that these are independent signs rather than a designed ecological foil.

changed_reading.before: One deficient awning fails against heat.
changed_reading.after: The verse negates an entire habitable environment: no stable containment, no cooling provision, and no relief from the inner or outer blaze.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later, protected people are located in plural shades and springs. That co-location supplies a positive control for the focus: true shade belongs to a protection-and-water bundle, whereas the three-branched object has shade-form without either protective or hydric efficacy.

activation_trace.role: Repelling harm by protection supplies the human state associated with genuine shade.
Plural shade as covering supplies the positive counterpart to the negated ظليل.
A spring as a source of running water supplies cooling provision alongside cover.
The denied covering in the focus is measured against the later successful covering.
Availing supplies the functional criterion met by the later bundle and failed by the focus shade.
Thirst-heat supplies the bodily need answered by springs but unanswered by the false shade.

structural_cues: 77:41 coordinates في ظلال وعيون inside one locative reward statement and places protection-bearing people within it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protected people, shades, and springs in one construction; I infer that their co-location defines a functional refuge bundle. They could be separate rewards, but their adjacency still sharpens what the focus shade lacks.

changed_reading.before: True and false shade differ mainly in intensity.
changed_reading.after: The surah functionally defines true shade by its ecology of protection and water; the focus object is counterfeit because its visible cover is detached from that bundle.

context_deltas.mechanism: After physical shelter fails, speech, permission to excuse, and strategic maneuver also fail. The focus's non-availing shade can therefore carry a procedural and social dimension: neither patronage nor advocacy nor countermeasure can stand between the exposed person and consequence.

activation_trace.role: Speech supplies the first possible means of defense that the context negates.
Permission supplies procedural access to a defense and is itself withheld.
Excuse or exculpation supplies the defense that cannot be presented.
Strategic deception or maneuver supplies a final attempted countermeasure that is challenged as futile.
Protective patronage anchors the social-defense extension in the focus word itself.
Standing in, benefiting, or availing supplies the shared failure criterion across shelter, excuse, and strategy.

structural_cues: The negations لا ينطقون and ولا يؤذن echo the focus's لا ... ولا pattern before the conditional challenge of 77:39.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successive losses of speech, permission, excuse, and strategy; I infer that they instantiate the same non-availing relation as failed patronage. Alternatively, those verses may concern agents rather than the shade, so the legal-social extension remains analogical.

changed_reading.before: Only a physical barrier fails against fire.
changed_reading.after: Every layer of defense fails in parallel: cover, patronage, speech, excuse, and strategy are all unable to intervene.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening movement sequence supplies violent scattering, spreading, and separation; the later shade supplies branching. Together with اللهب's rising dust-or-smoke branch, these cues permit a material model in which the threefold shade is a distributed plume field: mobile, divided emission rather than a stable roof.

activation_trace.role: A violent wind that lifts and scatters things supplies the plume's dispersive force.
Opening, spreading, and ramifying supply expansion into a broad field.
Scattering into parts supplies internal division rather than continuous cover.
Branching and divergence give the later field its explicit three-way geometry.
Rising dust or smoke named by likeness to flame supplies the material capable of casting a false shade.
Overhead canopy supplies the stable form against which the dispersed plume is judged and found deficient.

structural_cues: 77:2-4 form a rapid cognate-accusative sequence of storming, spreading, and separating; 77:30 later gives the shade three branches.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispersal, spreading, separation, branching, and a smoke-like flame branch; I infer a shared plume physics linking them. The live alternative is that the opening sequence has a different referent and contributes only a formal motion pattern.

changed_reading.before: A fixed canopy stands over the flame but is too weak.
changed_reading.after: The apparent canopy may be the flame's own mobile, three-way emission field, whose spreading geometry creates darkness without ever becoming shelter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the remote كذابة branch of ك ذ ب, a garment that misrepresents its condition. It remains anchored because 77:29 supplies denial, 77:30 names a cover, and 77:31 explicitly separates that cover's appearance from efficacy; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for counterfeit shelter, not as the lexical meaning of ظل here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The negated cover-quality of ظليل and denied efficacy of يغني allow appearance and performance to diverge.

activation_trace.role: A garment that lies by its condition supplies a covering whose appearance makes a false material claim.
Shade as covering supplies the surface that can falsely advertise protection.
The focus negates the covering's shade-quality and exposes the mismatch.
The availing test reveals that the covering's implied promise is false.

changed_reading.after: The shade behaves like a deceptive garment: its covering form advertises refuge while its material performance discloses the lie.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the form-distant branch in which approaching casts a shadow. It remains focus-anchored in ظليل beside an active flame and explains why an overshadowing presence can be the opposite of refuge; downstream prose should mark it as an imminence model, not replace the ordinary shade sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ظليل can be tested against the ظ ل ل branch of an event drawing near as though casting its shadow.

activation_trace.role: Approach as overshadowing turns the apparent shade into a sign that the hazard has drawn near.
Blazing flame supplies the approaching event whose cast shadow warns rather than protects.
Non-availing confirms that the overhang signals proximity and supplies no refuge.

changed_reading.before: A shadow is expected to mark shelter from a distant fire.
changed_reading.after: The shadow can mark the fire's imminence: what overshadows them is the arrival of danger, not an intervening shelter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the branch of لهب as a mountain gap or wall-like face rather than ordinary flame. It remains anchored in اللهب and gains geometric support from dismantled mountains and building-sized sparks; downstream prose should use it as a spatial analogy for hostile terrain, never as a claim that اللهب ceases to mean flame.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places failed overhead cover directly against اللهب, allowing the hazard to be modeled as enclosing terrain.

activation_trace.role: A mountain gap or wall-like mountain face supplies a topographic geometry internal to the focus hazard.
Overhead canopy supplies the sheltering geometry that the hostile terrain mimics but defeats.
A high solid mass supplies the ordinary terrain-scale barrier whose stability is removed in context.
An enclosed building supplies architectural scale to the adjacent sparks and makes the fire-field spatially inhabitable only as danger.

changed_reading.before: Flame is an object outside a failed shelter.
changed_reading.after: Flame becomes hostile topography: mountain-face and building-scale forms surround the exposed person, so apparent architecture belongs to the hazard rather than offering refuge from it.

strongest_changes: The three branches turn deficient shade into an anti-canopy whose structural multiplication never becomes protection.
The following throwing of building-scale sparks revises the cover from a weak barrier into part of the hazard's own emission system.
The later conjunction of protected people, shades, and springs supplies a positive functional control: true shade combines cover, protection, and water.
Earlier containment and fresh-water provision make the focus scene an anti-habitat rather than merely an overheated location.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah's two negations separate visible or named cover from causal efficacy. Whole-surah cues repeatedly exploit that split across physical canopy, optical darkness, habitat support, patronage, and procedural defense without forcing those mechanisms into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not settle the exact material identity of the three-branched shade; smoke or plume physics remains an inference.
The patronage, hydric, imminence, and hostile-topography activations are branch-grounded but more analogical than the immediate canopy reading.
The building comparison in 77:32 may mark scale alone rather than deliberately reverse the idea of shelter.
